text: nice! i should have said, the best way for these joint/pivot placements are to spawn a gizmo and let me place it with this, that way i can control the depth of where it sits, this lets us set a pivot in the middle of a tire, and then the joint in the center deadspace of the wheel base, and they both will connect at the point
resolution: Rig placement is gizmo-driven with depth control (req_1051 refinement on req_1025). Confirmed the selected pivot/joint wears the existing 3-axis TransformGizmo (move), so dragging the into-screen axis in the orbit view sets DEPTH — a pivot buried in the middle of a tire, a joint floating in the wheelbase deadspace. The only gap was needing a click-to-select to summon the gizmo; now entering rig mode default-selects the pivot (an effect keyed on selMode entry, so Esc still leaves nothing selected), so the gizmo spawns immediately and is there to grab. Studio.tsx bundles clean; hot-reload TSX, uncommitted. PLAYBOOK Part 6 build log updated.
